title: Hateful Memes Challenge: An Enhanced Multimodal Framework
findings: A positive correlation was found between the presence of text related to religion and a meme being labeled as hateful. Along with racism and gender, religion-related text had a relatively higher positive correlation with hateful memes compared to other sensitive categories.
